paragraphs: Facilitron connects people looking for event space with the public buildings and fields that can host them. The other half is management software designed for schools, colleges and cities that own those spaces.

Its scheduling platform holds internal bookings and community requests on one calendar, so staff can manage sports practices, plays and other events in the same place. Renters find, request, insure and pay for spaces online. Requests arrive already carrying the organization's own rates, policies and approval workflows. Facilitron collects the payments, automates invoices, facilitates renter insurance and manages credits and refunds. A building automation tie-in schedules HVAC, lighting, irrigation and locks around each event. A separate mobile tool handles California's Williams Act facility inspections.

Facilities from over 15,000 K-12 schools, colleges and municipalities are listed on the marketplace. School districts, municipalities, nonprofits and businesses all use it, whether to lease space out or to find it. The company states that its services are sustained through service fees on external rental amounts rather than direct charges.
